title: ottonia jaborandi
intro: Ottonia jaborandi, commonly known as Jaborandi, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest in South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including treating conditions such as hyperhidrosis (excessive sweating), alopecia (hair loss), and skin conditions like eczema and psoriasis. The therapeutic actions of Jaborandi are attributed to its ability to stimulate the sweat glands, promote hair growth, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, particularly pilocarpine, which is a muscarinic receptor agonist that stimulates sweat gland secretions and promotes hair growth.
